items.name: Thai Peanut Chicken Bowl
items.desc: Filled with fluffy rice, tender chicken, veggies, and covered in a creamy peanut sauce, these peanut chicken bowls check all the boxes.

items.name: Honey Sesame Chicken
items.desc: Juicy, flavor-packed chicken in a sweet and savory honey sesame stir fry sauce, alongside a bed of fluffy rice and tasty veggies.

items.name: Pretzel Crusted Pork Tenderloin
items.desc: Tender pork breaded with crispy pretzels and baked until perfectly golden. Served with sweet potatoes and green veggie. Get ready for a new favorite!

items.name: Loaded Breakfast Bowl
items.desc: Scrambled eggs & bacon paired with sweet potato and veggies will keep you full and happy until lunchtime!

items.name: Apple Pie Parfait
items.desc: High in protein and flavor, this parfait has it all: honey-vanilla yogurt, local apples to create a pie-like filling, and homemade granola!

items.name: Not Your Average Tomato Soup
items.desc: Comfort food made even better! This creamy, locally grown tomato-packed soup beats anything you can find in a can.

items.name: Jenny's Lasagna
items.desc: A longtime favorite meal of Jenny's family, her handcrafted lasagna has all the layers of cheesy, saucy, noodle-y goodness you crave. Starting with a homemade meat sauce and layered with thoughtful additions that take a basic dish to another level, you don't want to miss the chance to get a piece of this!
